_comment: Canonical event shapes expected by ACBU backend Horizon effect listeners. Verified against live Horizon testnet/mainnet contract_credited and contract_debited payloads (2026-08-22). When compiled WASM is added under contracts/ or wasm/, prefer generating Soroban contract-event shapes via stellar contract bindings json.

events.name: ContractCredited
events.notes: Live payload does not include recipient, to, value, or transaction_hash. Resolve tx hash via _links.operation → operation resource. Parsed by parseHorizonContractBalanceEffect.

events.name: ContractDebited
events.notes: Same field shape as ContractCredited. Used by burn listener primarily for operation/tx correlation.

events.name: MintEvent
events.notes: Application-level mapping of ContractCredited for the minting contract. Prefer parseHorizonContractBalanceEffect in acbu_minting_event_listener.

events.name: BurnEvent
events.notes: Application-level mapping of ContractDebited for the burning contract.

events.name: EscrowEvent
events.notes: Currently forwards validated payload to RabbitMQ via escrowEventProducer.

events.name: LendingPoolEvent
events.notes: Lightweight listener; tighten when contract events are available via RPC getEvents.

events.name: SavingsVaultEvent
events.notes: Lightweight listener; tighten when contract events are available via RPC getEvents.
